title: Broadcom Stock (AVGO) Falls 12.2% on Reports of Google Cut (Nov 20)
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) fell 12.19% to $304.41 on Nov 20 after an analyst said Google cut 2027 orders for Broadcom-designed TPU chips, unconfirmed so far.
body_markdown:
## Why Broadcom Stock Fell


Financial media tied the drop to a report from analyst Ming-Chi Kuo of TF International Securities. According to[StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/news/broadcom-falls-google-tpu-cut-mediatek/) , Kuo said in a November 20 post citing his latest industry survey that Google, part of[Alphabet (GOOGL)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/googl/) , is trimming 2027 shipments of its Broadcom-designed TPU 8i series by about 1 million units, or roughly 20%. Most of the cut hits the pricier 8i Max model, code-named Whalefish.


As reported by[Investing.com](https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/google-reportedly-cuts-broadcomdesigned-tpu-plans-eyes-more-mediatek-chips-4972824) , Kuo said Google plans to ship more of its TPU 8t series, which MediaTek designs, though the details remain unsettled. His post did not give pricing, contract terms or an estimate of the financial effect on Broadcom. Kuo linked the shift to Google giving frontier model development first call on compute amid tight supply and data center power limits.


The figures remain unconfirmed: StockAnalysis reported that neither Google nor Broadcom had commented publicly. Per[TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/google-2027-chip-plan-bad-194700249.html) , the drop erased close to $200 billion in Broadcom's market value and came during a broad chip selloff, in which Broadcom still fell harder than the semiconductor index. Investing.com noted that the decline should not be attributed solely to the reported shipment changes.


## AVGO Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Broadcom has a deal, signed in April, to supply future Google custom chips through 2031, according to TheStreet.
- On the September 2 earnings call, CEO Hock Tan said production shipments of the TPU 8i had started and that "our engagement with Google has never been stronger," per StockAnalysis.
- Broadcom earned $38.3 billion in profit on $89.1 billion in revenue over the trailing 12 months, TheStreet reported.


### Risks


- Kuo's survey points to Google moving some 2027 volume toward MediaTek-designed TPU 8t chips, according to Investing.com.
- Google supplier news has moved the stock before: TheStreet noted Broadcom fell about 5% in August after Marvell disclosed an expanded custom chip partnership with Google.
- The report landed in a wide selloff in chip stocks, StockAnalysis said, leaving Broadcom exposed to sector-wide moves as well as its own news.


Broadcom plans to report its[fiscal fourth-quarter results](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) on Wednesday, December 9, according to StockAnalysis, which called it the first chance for management to take questions on Google's 2027 plans.
